# tallao

> Svelte 5 UI kit for generative interfaces, extracted from the Kitsuden admin. Svelte 5 components in plain CSS on `--ta-*` tokens: accessible by keyboard and screen reader, SSR-ready, usable inside a Shadow DOM through ThemeScope.

Generated by `node scripts/llms.mjs` from `src/lib/components/*.svelte`; do not edit by hand.
Each component's header comment in its source file is the full contract (ARIA pattern, keyboard, SSR).

## Use

```svelte
<script>
  import "tallao/tokens.css";
  import "tallao/base.css";
  import { Button, Dialog } from "tallao";
  import { rise, collapse } from "tallao/motion";
</script>
```

- Texts are English by default; `setLabels(es)` in the root component switches them, and a label prop on a component wins.
- Popover, Tooltip and DropdownMenu take their trigger as a snippet: `{#snippet trigger(props)}<Button {...props}>…</Button>{/snippet}`.
- Compositions to copy: `src/AgentDemo.svelte` (an agent run screen), `src/AdminDemo.svelte` (a model list page and a record detail page), the `#dashboard` section of `src/App.svelte` (a public dashboard).
- Motion: `tallao/motion` (fade, rise, scaleIn, slide, collapse, stagger, crossfade, press, shimmer, shake, drawCheck, rollNumber, tabIndicator, viewTransition) on the tokens `--ta-duration-fast | base | slow` and `--ta-ease-out | in-out | spring`; all of it stops under reduced motion.

## Components (`tallao`)

### Button

Extracted from the Kitsuden admin and decoupled from Tailwind.

```svelte
<Button>…</Button>
```

Props:
- `variant?: "primary" | "secondary" | "danger" | "danger-ghost" | "ghost" | "outline" | "soft"` — `danger-ghost`: the quiet destructive action (red text, no fill until hover), for a row or a bar where a filled red button would weigh too much.
- `size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "icon"`
- `type?: "button" | "submit" | "reset"`
- `disabled?: boolean`
- `loading?: boolean`
- `class?: string`
- `href?: string`
- `ariaLabel?: string` — Accessible name: essential on an icon-only button.
- `title?: string`
- `children?: import("svelte").Snippet`
- `onclick?: (e: MouseEvent) => void`

### Badge

Status and category tags, rounded and with a soft border.

```svelte
<Badge>…</Badge>
```

Props:
- `variant?: Variant`
- `size?: Size`
- `tone?: "soft" | "solid"`
- `dot?: boolean` — A leading status dot in the variant's colour.
- `pulse?: boolean` — The dot pulses (live, running); still under reduced motion. Implies `dot`.
- `class?: string`
- `children: import("svelte").Snippet`

### Input

Text field with a focus state that matches the tokens.

```svelte
<Input />
```

Props:
- `value?: string`
- `ref?: HTMLInputElement`
- `class?: string`
- `type?: string`
- `disabled?: boolean`

### Dialog

Modal dialog built on the native <dialog> with showModal().

```svelte
<Dialog>…</Dialog>
```

Props:
- `open?: boolean`
- `title?: string`
- `description?: string`
- `size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl" | "2xl"`
- `showClose?: boolean`
- `closeLabel?: string` — Accessible name of the close button.
- `ariaLabel?: string` — Accessible name when there is no `title`.
- `showCloseAlone?: boolean` — Without `title`, still show the X (in the corner).
- `bare?: boolean` — No frame or padding: the content brings its own.
- `titleLevel?: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6`
- `closeOnBackdrop?: boolean` — Close on a click outside the panel (yes by default).
- `placement?: "center" | "left" | "right" | "top" | "bottom"` — Centred, or attached to an edge of the window (this is what Sheet uses).
- `class?: string`
- `onClose?: () => void`
- `onOpenChange?: (v: boolean) => void`
- `children?: import("svelte").Snippet`
- `footer?: import("svelte").Snippet`

### PromptInput

Input box for chatting with a model.

```svelte
<PromptInput />
```

Props:
- `value?: string` — Current text of the prompt (bindable).
- `placeholder?: string`
- `disabled?: boolean`
- `loading?: boolean`
- `attachments?: boolean` — Shows the attachments button and emits onAttach.
- `submitOnEnter?: boolean` — Sends on Enter (Shift+Enter = new line). Defaults to true.
- `ariaLabel?: string` — Accessible name of the field (defaults to the placeholder).
- `sendLabel?: string`
- `attachLabel?: string`
- `onSend?: (text: string) => void`
- `onAttach?: () => void`
- `class?: string`

### ToolCallCard

Card that shows an agent's tool call.

```svelte
<ToolCallCard name="…" />
```

Props:
- `name: string` — Name of the tool (e.g. "publish_post").
- `args?: Record<string, unknown>` — Arguments of the call; shown as JSON.
- `result?: string` — Result of the execution, if any.
- `status?: Status`
- `onApprove?: () => void` — When pending: decision buttons.
- `onReject?: () => void`
- `labels?: Partial<Pick<Labels, LabelKey>>` — This card's own texts; the rest come from setLabels (English by default).
- `class?: string`

### Select

Native drop-down list with the kit's tokens.

```svelte
<Select>…</Select>
```

Props:
- `value?: string`
- `ref?: HTMLSelectElement`
- `options?: SelectOption[]`
- `placeholder?: string` — Empty first option (value "").
- `size?: "sm" | "md"`
- `width?: "full" | "auto"` — `auto`: as wide as its longest option, for a row of filters.
- `class?: string`
- `disabled?: boolean`
- `children?: import("svelte").Snippet`

```svelte
<Textarea />
```

- `ref?: HTMLTextAreaElement`
- `rows?: number`
- `mono?: boolean` — Monospaced font (a card list, code, data).
- `class?: string`
- `disabled?: boolean`

- `class?: string`

### Field

Label + control + error.

```svelte
<Field label="…">…</Field>
```

Props:
- `label: string`
- `error?: string` — Error message under the control; it also marks the field.
- `required?: boolean`
- `class?: string`
- `children: import("svelte").Snippet`

### Tabs

Accessible tabs (tablist/tab/tabpanel) with arrows, Home and End.

```svelte
<Tabs items={[{ id: "a", label: "One", controls: "panel-a", tabId: "tab-a" }]} panels={false} bind:value />
```

Props:
- `items: TabItem[]`
- `value?: string`
- `ariaLabel?: string`
- `variant?: "underline" | "pills"` — `pills`: tabs as rounded buttons inside a frame.
- `tabClass?: string` — Classes for each tab (touch height on mobile, for example).
- `wrap?: boolean` — Tabs wrap onto several lines when they do not fit, instead of scrolling sideways.
- `panels?: boolean` — `false`: only the tablist; the page renders the panels (see `controls`).
- `tab?: import("svelte").Snippet<[TabItem, boolean]>` — Custom content for each tab (two lines, icon…); by default, label + count.
- `end?: import("svelte").Snippet` — Controls on the same row as the tabs, on the right (outside the tablist).
- `class?: string`
- `onchange?: (id: string) => void`
- `children?: import("svelte").Snippet<[string]>`

```svelte
<Alert>…</Alert>
```

- `title?: string`
- `onDismiss?: () => void`

### ConfirmDialog

A confirmation built on Dialog.

```svelte
<ConfirmDialog title="…" {onConfirm}>…</ConfirmDialog>
```

Props:
- `open?: boolean`
- `title: string`
- `description?: string`
- `confirmLabel?: string`
- `cancelLabel?: string`
- `closeLabel?: string`
- `variant?: "primary" | "danger"`
- `onConfirm: () => void | Promise<void>`
- `onCancel?: () => void` — Closed without confirming: Cancel, Escape, the X or a click outside.
- `onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void`
- `children?: import("svelte").Snippet`

### ThemeScope

Defines the `--ta-*` tokens on a container instead of on `:root`.

```svelte
<ThemeScope>…</ThemeScope>
```

Props:
- `source?: "kitsuden" | "tallao"`
- `class?: string`
- `children?: import("svelte").Snippet`

### Popover

Floating panel anchored to a trigger.

```svelte
<Popover title="Filters">
  {#snippet trigger(props)}<Button {...props}>Filters</Button>{/snippet}
  …content…
</Popover>
```

Props:
- `open?: boolean`
- `placement?: Placement`
- `title?: string` — Panel title: it is also its accessible name.
- `ariaLabel?: string` — Accessible name when there is no `title`.
- `class?: string`
- `onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void`
- `trigger: import("svelte").Snippet<[TriggerProps]>`
- `children?: import("svelte").Snippet`

### Tooltip

Short text that describes a control, on hover or when it gets keyboard focus (WCAG 1.4.13.

```svelte
<Tooltip text="Copy link">
  {#snippet trigger(props)}<Button {...props} size="icon" ariaLabel="Copy">⧉</Button>{/snippet}
</Tooltip>
```

Props:
- `text: string`
- `placement?: Placement`
- `delay?: number` — Wait before showing on hover, in ms (focus shows it immediately).
- `trigger: import("svelte").Snippet<[TriggerProps]>`

### DropdownMenu

Action menu for a button (the WAI-ARIA APG "menu button" pattern).

```svelte
<DropdownMenu label="Project actions">
  {#snippet trigger(props)}<Button {...props}>Actions</Button>{/snippet}
  <MenuItem onSelect={edit}>Edit</MenuItem>
  <MenuSeparator />
  <MenuItem variant="danger" onSelect={remove}>Delete</MenuItem>
</DropdownMenu>
```

Props:
- `label: string` — Accessible name of the menu.
- `open?: boolean`
- `placement?: Placement`
- `class?: string`
- `onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void`
- `trigger: import("svelte").Snippet<[TriggerProps]>`
- `children?: import("svelte").Snippet`

### MenuItem

An option of a DropdownMenu.

```svelte
<MenuItem>…</MenuItem>
```

Props:
- `onSelect?: () => void`
- `disabled?: boolean`
- `variant?: "default" | "danger"`
- `closeOnSelect?: boolean`
- `checked?: boolean` — On or off: makes the option a `menuitemcheckbox` (or a radio, see `checkType`).
- `checkType?: "checkbox" | "radio"`
- `class?: string`
- `children: import("svelte").Snippet`

### MenuSeparator

line between groups of options in a DropdownMenu.

```svelte
<MenuSeparator />
```

### MenuLabel

heading of a group of options inside a DropdownMenu (cannot be chosen).

```svelte
<MenuLabel>…</MenuLabel>
```

Props:
- `children: import("svelte").Snippet`

### Combobox

Text field with a list of options filtered as you type (WAI-ARIA 1.2 combobox pattern, with aria-activedescendant.

```svelte
<Combobox />
```

Props:
- `options?: ComboboxOption[]` — Local options; with `loadOptions` they may be omitted (they come from the API).
- `value?: string | null`
- `values?: string[]` — With `multiple`: the chosen values.
- `multiple?: boolean`
- `loadOptions?: (query: string, signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<ComboboxOption[]>` — Options from the API for the typed text; `signal` is aborted if another search arrives.
- `debounce?: number` — Wait after the last keystroke before searching the API, in ms.
- `minChars?: number` — Minimum characters to search the API.
- `name?: string` — Field name in a form (hidden inputs with the value or values).
- `required?: boolean`
- `placeholder?: string`
- `ariaLabel?: string` — Accessible name if it is not inside a Field.
- `emptyText?: string` — List text when nothing matches.
- `loadingText?: string`
- `removeLabel?: (label: string) => string` — Name of the button that removes a chip (`multiple` mode).
- `disabled?: boolean`
- `filter?: (option: ComboboxOption, query: string) => boolean` — Custom filter for local options; defaults to "contains", ignoring case and accents.
- `class?: string`
- `onValueChange?: (value: string | null) => void`
- `onValuesChange?: (values: string[]) => void`

### Switch

On/off switch (role="switch", WAI-ARIA APG).

```svelte
<Switch>…</Switch>
```

Props:
- `checked?: boolean`
- `label?: string`
- `ariaLabel?: string`
- `disabled?: boolean`
- `size?: "sm" | "md"`
- `name?: string` — Name in a form: on submits `name=value`, off submits nothing (like a checkbox).
- `value?: string`
- `class?: string`
- `onchange?: (checked: boolean) => void`
- `children?: import("svelte").Snippet`

### RadioGroup

Choose one option among a few, all visible.

```svelte
<RadioGroup {options} legend="…" />
```

Props:
- `options: RadioOption[]`
- `value?: string`
- `legend: string`
- `hideLegend?: boolean`
- `orientation?: "vertical" | "horizontal"`
- `name?: string`
- `disabled?: boolean`
- `required?: boolean`
- `class?: string`
- `onchange?: (value: string) => void`

### Sheet

Modal side panel (a record's detail, settings, a cart).

```svelte
<Sheet>…</Sheet>
```

Props:
- `open?: boolean`
- `side?: "left" | "right" | "top" | "bottom"`
- `title?: string`
- `description?: string`
- `size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl" | "2xl"` — Width of the side panel (does not apply to top or bottom).
- `closeLabel?: string`
- `ariaLabel?: string`
- `class?: string`
- `onClose?: () => void`
- `children?: import("svelte").Snippet`
- `footer?: import("svelte").Snippet`

### Toaster

Where the `toast()` notifications appear.

```svelte
<Toaster />
```

Props:
- `position?: "top-right" | "top-left" | "bottom-right" | "bottom-left" | "top-center" | "bottom-center"`
- `label?: string` — Name of the region.
- `dismissLabel?: string`
- `class?: string`

### Command

Command palette (⌘K / Ctrl+K).

```svelte
<Command bind:open items={[
  { id: "new", label: "New project", group: "Projects", shortcut: "N", onSelect: create },
  { id: "theme", label: "Toggle theme", keywords: ["dark", "light"], onSelect: toggleTheme },
]} />
```

Props:
- `open?: boolean`
- `query?: string` — What is typed in the search box.
- `inputRef?: HTMLInputElement` — The search box <input> (to focus it from outside).
- `items: CommandItem[]`
- `filter?: boolean` — `false`: the page supplies results already filtered; the palette renders them as they are.
- `loading?: boolean` — Results on the way: loading indicator and the list marked as busy.
- `inline?: boolean` — No dialog or shortcut: the search box and the list inside the page's backdrop.
- `autofocus?: boolean` — In `inline`, focus the search box on mount.
- `placeholder?: string`
- `label?: string` — Accessible name of the palette.
- `emptyText?: string | ((query: string) => string)` — No results. In a string, `{query}` is replaced with what was typed (in a Svelte template, inside braces: `emptyText={"Nothing for \"{query}\""}`); or a function.
- `loadingLabel?: string` — Screen reader name of the loading indicator.
- `hotkey?: boolean`
- `class?: string`
- `onSelect?: (item: CommandItem) => void` — After choosing any result (after its own onSelect).
- `onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void` — It closes (Escape, choosing) or opens. In `inline`, so the page can remove its backdrop.
- `empty?: Snippet<[string]>` — What shows with no results; receives the query (empty before typing).
- `leading?: Snippet<[CommandItem, boolean]>` — Before each result's text (an icon); receives the result and whether it is active.
- `trailing?: Snippet<[CommandItem, boolean]>` — At the end of each result (an arrow, a number).

### ContextMenu

Right-click menu over an area.

```svelte
<ContextMenu label="Row actions">
  {#snippet target(props)}<tr {...props}>…</tr>{/snippet}
  <MenuItem onSelect={openRow}>Open</MenuItem>
</ContextMenu>
```

Props:
- `label: string` — Accessible name of the menu.
- `class?: string`
- `target: import("svelte").Snippet<[TriggerProps]>` — The area it opens over; receives the props to spread on its element.
- `children?: import("svelte").Snippet`

### Avatar

Photo of a person or agent with fallback initials.

```svelte
<Avatar name="…" />
```

Props:
- `name: string`
- `src?: string | null`
- `size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg"`
- `shape?: "circle" | "square"`
- `decorative?: boolean`
- `badge?: string`
- `initials?: 1 | 2` — How many initials to draw (default 2).
- `aria-label?: string` — Accessible name; defaults to `name`.
- `class?: string`

### SelectionBar

Selection bar for bulk actions on a list.

```svelte
<SelectionBar {total} {selected} {onToggleAll} />
```

Props:
- `total: number` — How many items can be checked (those in the visible list).
- `selected: number` — How many are checked.
- `onToggleAll: (checked: boolean) => void` — The "select all" checkbox: `true` checks all, `false` unchecks them.
- `selectAllLabel?: string`
- `countLabel?: (selected: number) => string` — Text of the counter.
- `ariaLabel?: string` — Name of the group for screen readers.
- `class?: string`
- `actions?: Snippet` — The bulk actions; rendered only when something is checked.

### KeyValueEditor

List of key → value pairs, each with a remove button, plus a row to add another (variables, headers, column-to-field maps…).

```svelte
<KeyValueEditor />
```

Props:
- `entries?: KeyValueEntry[]`
- `keyOptions?: string[]` — The key is picked from this list instead of typed.
- `keyPlaceholder?: string`
- `valuePlaceholder?: string`
- `valueType?: "text" | "number"`
- `separator?: string` — What is drawn between key and value in each row ("=", "→", ":"…).
- `unique?: boolean` — With `true`, adding a key that already exists changes its value instead of repeating it.
- `keyLabel?: string` — Accessible names of the two fields in the add row.
- `valueLabel?: string`
- `addLabel?: string`
- `removeLabel?: string` — Text of the remove button; its accessible name appends the key.
- `emptyText?: string` — What shows when there are no pairs: the list does not disappear.
- `disabled?: boolean`
- `name?: string` — Name in a form: each pair is submitted as `name[key]=value`.
- `class?: string`
- `onchange?: (entries: KeyValueEntry[]) => void`

### CopyButton

a piece of text copied to the clipboard with one click.

```svelte
<CopyButton text="…" />
```

Props:
- `text: string` — What gets copied.
- `label?: string` — What is shown; by default, the text itself.
- `copyLabel?: string` — Accessible name and title of the button.
- `copiedLabel?: string` — Notice after copying.
- `resetAfter?: number` — How long the notice lasts, in ms.
- `disabled?: boolean`
- `class?: string`
- `onCopy?: (text: string) => void`

### DragBoard

Move items between zones (rows of a tier list, columns of a board…) with the mouse AND with the keyboard.

```svelte
<DragBoard bind:selected onMove={(item, zone) => move(item, zone)}>
  {#each rows as r (r.id)}
    <DropZone id={r.id} label={r.name}>
      {#each r.things as t (t.id)}
        <DragItem id={t.id} label={t.name} zone={r.id}>{t.name}</DragItem>
      {/each}
    </DropZone>
  {/each}
</DragBoard>
```

Props:
- `selected?: string | null` — Selected item; null if there is none.
- `onMove: (item: string, zone: string) => void | Promise<void>` — Item `item` moves to zone `zone` (different from its own).
- `instructions?: string` — Keyboard instructions a screen reader hears on reaching an item.
- `announcements?: Partial<DragAnnouncements>` — Announcements for each step; missing ones are in English.
- `class?: string`
- `children?: import("svelte").Snippet`

### DropZone

A zone of a DragBoard where items land.

```svelte
<DropZone id="…" label="…">…</DropZone>
```

Props:
- `id: string`
- `label: string` — Accessible name of the zone.
- `class?: string`
- `children?: import("svelte").Snippet`

### DragItem

An item that moves between the DropZones of a DragBoard.

```svelte
<DragItem id="…" label="…" zone="…">…</DragItem>
```

Props:
- `id: string`
- `label: string` — Name of the item in the board's announcements.
- `zone: string` — Id of the DropZone it is in now.
- `disabled?: boolean`
- `title?: string`
- `class?: string`
- `children?: import("svelte").Snippet`

### ChatMessage

one message in a conversation, with who said it and its text.

```svelte
<ChatMessage>…</ChatMessage>
```

Props:
- `role?: Role`
- `author?: string` — Who is speaking; defaults to the role in English ("You", "Assistant", "System").
- `content?: string` — The message text; `children` replaces it if markup is needed.
- `pending?: boolean` — While the reply arrives: animated dots and `aria-busy`.
- `pendingLabel?: string` — Accessible name of the waiting indicator.
- `class?: string`
- `children?: import("svelte").Snippet`
- `footer?: import("svelte").Snippet`

### DataTable

Data table built on Table.

```svelte
<DataTable rows={contacts} rowKey="id" columns={[
  { key: "name", header: "Name", sortable: true, filter: "text" },
  { key: "team", header: "Team", filter: "select" },
  { key: "score", header: "Points", sortable: true, align: "right", filter: "range" },
]} pageSize={20} selectable bind:selected bind:filters>
  {#snippet cell(row, col)}{#if col.key === "name"}<a href={`/c/${row.id}`}>{row.name}</a>{:else}{row[col.key]}{/if}{/snippet}
</DataTable>
```

Props:
- `rows: T[]`
- `columns: DataColumn<T>[]`
- `rowKey: keyof T | ((row: T) => string)` — Field or function that gives each row's unique key.
- `rowLabel?: (row: T) => string`
- `sort?: DataSort | null`
- `page?: number`
- `pageSize?: number` — Rows per page; without it, there is no pagination.
- `total?: number` — With `manual`: how many rows the API has in total.
- `manual?: boolean`
- `selectable?: boolean`
- `selected?: string[]`
- `loading?: boolean`
- `emptyText?: string`
- `filters?: DataFilters` — Column filter values by column key (bindable).
- `noMatchesText?: string` — Empty row when the filters leave no rows.
- `caption?: string`
- `density?: DataDensity` — Row height (bindable).
- `densityToggle?: boolean` — Shows the density toggle in the toolbar.
- `visibleColumns?: string[]` — Keys of the columns shown (bindable); without it, all of them.
- `columnChooser?: boolean` — Shows the column menu in the toolbar.
- `rowHref?: (row: T) => string | undefined` — Where a row leads: its first cell (or `linkColumn`) becomes a link.
- `linkColumn?: string` — Key of the column that carries the row's link; the first one shown by default.
- `loadingRows?: number` — How many skeleton rows `loading` draws (by default the page size, 5 at most).
- `error?: string | null` — The load failed: this message replaces the rows.
- `onRetry?: () => void` — Adds "Retry" to the error state.
- `compactLabel?: string`
- `columnsLabel?: string`
- `class?: string`
- `cell?: Snippet<[T, DataColumn<T>]>` — Custom cell content; without it, the value as text.
- `actions?: Snippet<[T]>` — Last column with per-row actions.
- `rowActions?: Snippet<[T]>` — Per-row actions in a last column that stays in view when the table scrolls sideways.
- `toolbar?: Snippet` — Your own content at the start of the toolbar.
- `empty?: Snippet<[{ filtered: boolean; clear: () => void }]>` — Replaces the default empty state.
- `errorState?: Snippet<[string]>` — Replaces the default error state; gets the message.
- `onDensityChange?: (density: DataDensity) => void`
- `onVisibleColumnsChange?: (keys: string[]) => void`
- `onSortChange?: (sort: DataSort | null) => void`
- `onPageChange?: (page: number) => void`
- `onSelectionChange?: (selected: string[]) => void`
- `onFiltersChange?: (filters: DataFilters) => void` — A filter control changed (the whole state). With `manual`, send it to the API.

### Calendar

A month to pick a day (grid from the WAI-ARIA APG "date picker" pattern).

```svelte
<Calendar />
```

Props:
- `value?: ISODate | null`
- `min?: ISODate`
- `max?: ISODate`
- `locale?: string`
- `weekStartsOn?: number`
- `isDisabled?: (iso: ISODate) => boolean`
- `previousLabel?: string`
- `nextLabel?: string`
- `class?: string`
- `onselect?: (iso: ISODate) => void`

- `disabled?: boolean`
- `placeholder?: string`

- `buttonLabel?: string`
- `class?: string`
- `onchange?: (value: ISODate | null) => void`

### MonthView

A whole month to look at (schedule, events, tournaments), with custom content in each day.

```svelte

```

Props:
- `month?: ISODate` — Any day of the month shown (changing month leaves day 1); defaults to today.
- `locale?: string`
- `weekStartsOn?: number` — First day of the week: 0 Sunday, 1 Monday (default).
- `showOutsideDays?: boolean` — With false, days of neighboring months are empty cells.
- `headingLevel?: 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6`
- `previousLabel?: string`
- `nextLabel?: string`
- `class?: string`
- `onmonthchange?: (month: ISODate) => void` — When the month changes from the buttons or the keyboard, with day 1 of the new month.
- `day?: Snippet<[MonthViewDay]>` — What goes in each day, below its number.

### BarChart

Bars per category, one or several series.

```svelte
<BarChart {data} x="…" {series} title="…" />
```

Props:
- `data: Record<string, unknown>[]`
- `x: string`
- `series: ChartSeries[]`
- `title: string` — What the chart shows: its accessible name and the figure caption.
- `hideTitle?: boolean` — Keeps the title for screen readers only (inside a ChartCard that already shows it).
- `xLabel?: string`
- `height?: number` — Height in px: 240 for columns; horizontal bars grow with the number of rows.
- `orientation?: "vertical" | "horizontal"` — Columns (`vertical`) or bars that run left to right (`horizontal`).
- `stacked?: boolean` — One bar per category with the series piled up, instead of side by side.
- `locale?: string`
- `format?: (n: number) => string` — Format of the values on axes, tooltip and table.
- `emptyText?: string` — Text shown when `data` is empty.
- `totalLabel?: string` — Name of the sum of a stacked bar, in the tooltip and the table.
- `showDataLabel?: string`
- `hideDataLabel?: string`
- `class?: string`

### LineChart

Change over time.

```svelte
<LineChart {data} x="…" {series} title="…" />
```

Props:
- `data: Record<string, unknown>[]`
- `x: string`
- `series: ChartSeries[]`
- `title: string`
- `hideTitle?: boolean` — Keeps the title for screen readers only (inside a ChartCard that already shows it).
- `xLabel?: string`
- `height?: number`
- `area?: boolean` — Fill under the line, at 10% of the series color.
- `stacked?: boolean` — Stacked areas: every series is drawn on top of the previous ones.
- `domain?: [number, number]` — Lower and upper bound of the scale, instead of zero to the maximum (ignored when stacked).
- `locale?: string`
- `format?: (n: number) => string`
- `emptyText?: string` — Text shown when `data` is empty.
- `totalLabel?: string` — Name of the sum of the series when stacked, in the tooltip and the table.
- `showDataLabel?: string`
- `hideDataLabel?: string`
- `class?: string`

- `children?: import("svelte").Snippet` — More fields after the schema's and before the button (a CodeEditor, a FileUpload…).

- `showValue?: boolean` — Shows the value next to the label.
- `marks?: { value: number; label: string }[]` — Labels under the track, placed at their value.
- `name?: string`

### ToggleGroup

Filters or modes as a row of pressable buttons (aria-pressed) inside a named group.

```svelte
<ToggleGroup {options} />
```

Props:
- `options: ToggleOption[]`
- `type?: "single" | "multiple"`
- `value?: string`
- `values?: string[]`
- `label?: string` — Name of the group (the screen reader hears it; visible with hideLabel={false}).
- `ariaLabel?: string` — Name of the group without a visible label of its own.
- `variant?: "pills" | "segmented" | "bare"` — `segmented`: equal-width buttons, joined, full width. `bare`: no frame, for icons.
- `tone?: "tint" | "solid"` — Pressed: `tint` (soft accent) or `solid` (accent background).
- `itemClass?: string` — Classes for each button (touch height on mobile, for example).
- `hideLabel?: boolean`
- `dimOthers?: boolean` — Dim the unpressed buttons while any is pressed (by default, only in `bare`).
- `required?: boolean` — In `single`, always keep one pressed.
- `size?: "sm" | "md"`
- `name?: string`
- `disabled?: boolean`
- `class?: string`
- `onchange?: (value: string) => void`
- `onValuesChange?: (values: string[]) => void`
- `item?: import("svelte").Snippet<[ToggleOption, boolean]>` — Custom content for each button (icon + text).

### NumberInput

A real number.

```svelte
<NumberInput />
```

Props:
- `value?: number | null`
- `min?: number`
- `max?: number`
- `step?: number`
- `stepper?: boolean` — − and + buttons on the sides.
- `clamp?: boolean` — On leaving, clamp a value outside `min`/`max` to the bound. Without it, the value stays and the consumer validates it (a form that warns "at most 100").
- `width?: "full" | "auto"`
- `size?: "sm" | "md"`
- `name?: string`
- `id?: string`
- `placeholder?: string`
- `disabled?: boolean`
- `ariaLabel?: string`
- `decrementLabel?: string`
- `incrementLabel?: string`
- `class?: string`
- `inputClass?: string`
- `onchange?: (value: number | null) => void` — On every new value (typed, from the buttons, or clamped on leaving).
- `onblur?: (e: FocusEvent) => void` — In addition to the component's own clamping on leaving.

### Carousel


Props:

- `label?: string` — Name of the region (the screen reader hears it).
- `slideLabel?: (n: number, total: number) => string` — Name of each slide ("3 of 8").
- `slideWidth?: string` — Width of each card (any CSS length; "100%" = one per view).
- `gap?: string` — Gap between cards.
- `autoplay?: boolean`
- `interval?: number` — Milliseconds between automatic steps.
- `rotationControl?: boolean` — With `autoplay`, the button that stops and resumes it.
- `previousLabel?: string`
- `nextLabel?: string`
- `class?: string`
- `slideClass?: string` — Classes of each slide.
- `empty?: Snippet` — What shows when there are no items.

### UsageMeter


### InputOTP

A one-time code field (SMS or e-mail codes, 2FA).

```svelte
<InputOTP bind:value={code} length={6} groupSize={3} name="code" oncomplete={verify} />
```

Props:
- `value?: string`
- `length?: number` — Number of slots (default 6).
- `pattern?: "digits" | "alphanumeric"` — Allowed characters: digits (default) or letters and digits.
- `groupSize?: number` — Draws a separator every `groupSize` slots (e.g. 3 → "123 456"). Visual only.
- `oncomplete?: (value: string) => void` — Called once the last slot is filled, with the whole code.
- `name?: string` — Name in a form: the real input is submitted, also without JavaScript.
- `label?: string` — Accessible name; defaults to the `oneTimeCode` text.
- `disabled?: boolean`
- `invalid?: boolean`
- `required?: boolean`
- `autocomplete?: import("svelte/elements").FullAutoFill`
- `inputmode?: "numeric" | "text"` — Virtual keyboard; by default `numeric` for digits and `text` otherwise.
- `ref?: HTMLInputElement` — The native element (bind:ref).
- `class?: string`

### BottomNav

A mobile tab bar fixed to the bottom of the screen.

```svelte
<BottomNav current="/news" hideAbove={767} items={[
  { id: "home", label: "Home", href: "/", icon: "home" },
  { id: "news", label: "News", href: "/news", icon: "info", badge: 3 },
  { id: "me", label: "Profile", href: "/me", icon: "user" },
]} />
```

Props:
- `items: BottomNavItem[]`
- `current?: string` — Id or href of the current page.
- `ariaLabel?: string` — Accessible name of the <nav>.
- `hideAbove?: number` — Only shown when the viewport is at most this wide, in px (e.g. 767).
- `spacer?: boolean` — Keeps a spacer of the bar's height in the flow, so the page's end stays visible.
- `action?: Snippet` — A raised central action (a link or button with its own name).
- `icon?: Snippet<[BottomNavItem, boolean]>` — Draws every item's icon (your own icon set); gets the item and whether it is current.
- `class?: string`

### NavMenu

A disclosure menu for a site header.

```svelte
<NavMenu label="Games" groups={[
  { label: "Gacha", items: [{ label: "Genshin", href: "/genshin", description: "Tier list and builds", icon: "bot" }] },
  { label: "Soon", items: [{ label: "Aion 2", description: "Wiki in progress", soon: true }] },
]} />
```

Props:
- `label: string` — Text of the trigger.
- `groups: NavMenuGroup[]`
- `open?: boolean`
- `columns?: 1 | 2 | 3 | "auto"` — Columns of groups in the panel; "auto" uses one per group, up to 3.
- `align?: "start" | "end"` — Edge of the trigger the panel lines up with. With JavaScript, "start" flips to "end" if it would overflow.
- `name?: string` — Same `name` on several menus: opening one closes the others (native, no JavaScript).
- `soonLabel?: string` — Text of the tag on `soon` entries.
- `trigger?: Snippet` — Your own trigger content (the chevron is added after it).
- `icon?: Snippet<[NavMenuItem]>` — Draws every item's icon with your own icon set.
- `item?: Snippet<[NavMenuItem]>` — Replaces a whole entry's content (inside the link).
- `class?: string`
- `panelClass?: string`

### MegaMenu

A header trigger that opens a wide bento panel.

```svelte
<MegaMenu label="Games"
  featured={{ title: "Elden Ring", href: "/elden-ring/", image: "/er.jpg", cta: "Open hub",
              description: "Guides, bosses and the interactive map" }}
  groups={[
    { label: "Valhalla", items: [{ label: "Elden Ring", href: "/elden-ring/", description: "Wiki + guides" }] },
    { label: "Cardback", items: [{ label: "Marvel Snap", href: "/snap/", soon: false }] },
  ]}
  foot={{ label: "All games", href: "/games" }} />
```

Props:
- `label: string` — Text of the trigger.
- `groups: NavMenuGroup[]`
- `featured?: MegaMenuFeatured` — The big tile of the bento; without it the panel is plain columns.
- `foot?: MegaMenuFoot` — The closing row of the panel ("View all →").
- `open?: boolean`
- `columns?: 1 | 2 | 3 | "auto"` — Columns of groups next to the featured tile; "auto" uses one per group, up to 3.
- `align?: "start" | "end"` — Edge of the trigger the panel lines up with. With JavaScript, "start" flips to "end" if it would overflow.
- `name?: string` — Same `name` on several menus: opening one closes the others (native, no JavaScript).
- `soonLabel?: string` — Text of the tag on `soon` entries.
- `trigger?: Snippet` — Your own trigger content (the chevron is added after it).
- `icon?: Snippet<[NavMenuItem]>` — Draws every item's icon with your own icon set.
- `item?: Snippet<[NavMenuItem]>` — Replaces a whole entry's content (inside the link).
- `class?: string`
- `panelClass?: string`

### ChartLegend

The key of a chart.

```svelte
<ChartLegend {items} />
```

Props:
- `items: ChartLegendItem[]`
- `marker?: "square" | "line" | "dot"` — Shape of the marks: a square (bars, slices), a line (lines) or a dot.
- `orientation?: "horizontal" | "vertical"` — In a row that wraps, or one entry per line with the values aligned to the right.
- `class?: string`

### DonutChart

Parts of a whole.

```svelte
<DonutChart {data} title="…" />
```

Props:
- `data: DonutSlice[]`
- `title: string` — What the chart shows: its accessible name and the figure caption.
- `hideTitle?: boolean` — Keeps the title for screen readers only (inside a ChartCard that already shows it).
- `innerRadius?: number` — Hole as a fraction of the radius, 0 to 0.9; `0` draws a pie.
- `size?: number` — Diameter in px (it shrinks to fit a narrow container).
- `centerLabel?: string` — Caption under the figure in the centre ("Total" by default).
- `centerValue?: string` — Figure in the centre; by default the formatted total.
- `legend?: "right" | "bottom" | "hidden"` — Where the legend goes; `hidden` keeps it for screen readers only.
- `maxSlices?: number` — Slices drawn before the rest are grouped into "Other".
- `otherLabel?: string`
- `locale?: string`
- `format?: (n: number) => string` — Format of the values in the legend and the centre.
- `emptyText?: string` — Text shown when there is nothing to draw.
- `class?: string`

### ScatterChart

Two measures against each other, one point per item (pick rate against win rate of every character).

```svelte
<ScatterChart {data} title="…" xLabel="…" yLabel="…" />
```

Props:
- `data: ScatterPoint[]`
- `title: string` — What the chart shows: its accessible name and the figure caption.
- `hideTitle?: boolean` — Keeps the title for screen readers only (inside a ChartCard that already shows it).
- `xLabel: string` — Name of the horizontal measure (axis title, tooltip, table header).
- `yLabel: string` — Name of the vertical measure.
- `height?: number`
- `xDomain?: [number, number]` — Bounds of each axis, instead of round numbers around the data.
- `yDomain?: [number, number]`
- `xRef?: number` — A dashed reference line at this x / y value.
- `yRef?: number`
- `showLabels?: boolean` — Prints every point's label next to it.
- `locale?: string`
- `format?: (n: number) => string` — Format of both measures, unless `xFormat` / `yFormat` say otherwise.
- `xFormat?: (n: number) => string`
- `yFormat?: (n: number) => string`
- `labelHeader?: string` — Headers of the label and group columns of the data table.
- `groupHeader?: string`
- `emptyText?: string` — Text shown when there are no points.
- `showDataLabel?: string`
- `hideDataLabel?: string`
- `class?: string`

### Heatmap

A matrix of values.

```svelte
<Heatmap {data} title="…" />
```

Props:
- `data: HeatmapCell[]`
- `title: string` — What the matrix shows: its caption and accessible name.
- `hideTitle?: boolean` — Keeps the title for screen readers only (inside a ChartCard that already shows it).
- `xs?: string[]` — Order of the columns (and columns to show even when empty).
- `ys?: string[]` — Order of the rows.
- `cornerLabel?: string` — Text of the top-left corner: what the rows are ("Attacker").
- `showValues?: boolean` — Prints the value in every cell.
- `min?: number` — Value of the lightest and the darkest shade; by default the data's own range.
- `max?: number`
- `color?: string` — Any CSS colour for the shade; by default the first series colour.
- `locale?: string`
- `format?: (n: number) => string` — Format of the values.
- `emptyText?: string` — Text shown when `data` is empty.
- `class?: string`

### Funnel

How many make it through each step of a sequence (visited → signed up → played a match → came back).

```svelte
<Funnel {data} title="…" />
```

Props:
- `data: FunnelStep[]`
- `title: string` — What the funnel shows: its caption and the list's accessible name.
- `hideTitle?: boolean` — Keeps the title for screen readers only (inside a ChartCard that already shows it).
- `align?: "center" | "left"` — Bars centred (the funnel shape) or starting at the left edge.
- `color?: string` — Any CSS colour for the bars; by default the first series colour.
- `locale?: string`
- `format?: (n: number) => string` — Format of the values.
- `stepLabel?: string` — "{percent} of the previous step".
- `emptyText?: string` — Text shown when `data` is empty.
- `class?: string`

### BarList

A ranking.

```svelte
<BarList {data} />
```

Props:
- `data: BarListItem[]`
- `title?: string` — What is ranked: the visible heading and the list's accessible name.
- `ariaLabel?: string` — Accessible name when there is no visible `title`.
- `ranked?: boolean` — Numbers the rows (1, 2, 3…) in an ordered list.
- `max?: number` — Value of a full bar; by default the largest value.
- `limit?: number` — Rows shown.
- `color?: string` — Any CSS colour for the bars; by default the first series colour.
- `locale?: string`
- `format?: (n: number) => string` — Format of the values.
- `emptyText?: string` — Text shown when `data` is empty.
- `class?: string`

### Sparkline

A trend in the space of a word.

```svelte
<Sparkline {data} label="…" />
```

Props:
- `data: number[]`
- `label: string` — What the trend measures: the start of its accessible name.
- `width?: number`
- `height?: number`
- `variant?: "line" | "bar"` — A line, or one small column per value.
- `area?: boolean` — Soft fill under the line.
- `color?: string` — Any CSS colour; by default the first series colour.
- `locale?: string`
- `format?: (n: number) => string` — Format of the figures in the accessible name.
- `ariaLabel?: string` — Full accessible name, instead of the generated summary.
- `class?: string`

### KpiCard

One headline figure of a dashboard.

```svelte
<KpiCard label="…" {value} />
```

Props:
- `label: string`
- `value: number | string` — A number (formatted with `format`) or a text shown as is.
- `unit?: string` — Text after the value, smaller ("%", "ms", "players").
- `delta?: number | null` — Change since the previous period, in the units `deltaFormat` writes.
- `deltaLabel?: string` — What the change is compared with ("vs last patch").
- `goodWhen?: "up" | "down" | "none"` — Which direction of change is good; `none` shows it without a verdict.
- `trend?: number[]` — Recent values, oldest first, drawn as a sparkline.
- `target?: number` — Goal for a numeric value: shows a bar with the progress towards it.
- `targetLabel?: string`
- `locale?: string`
- `format?: (n: number) => string` — Format of the value and the target.
- `deltaFormat?: (n: number) => string` — Format of the change (by default a signed number: "+1.8").
- `span?: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | "full"` — Columns it takes inside a DashboardGrid (`"full"`: the whole row).
- `class?: string`

### Gauge

One value inside a known range, as a half dial (`variant="semi"`) or a full ring (`variant="ring"`, a radial progress).

```svelte
<Gauge {value} label="…" />
```

Props:
- `value: number`
- `min?: number`
- `max?: number`
- `label: string` — What is measured: the accessible name and the caption.
- `variant?: "semi" | "ring"` — A half dial, or a full ring.
- `tone?: "default" | "success" | "warning" | "error"` — Colour of the arc.
- `target?: number` — A goal inside the range, marked with a tick.
- `targetLabel?: string`
- `size?: number` — Width in px (it shrinks to fit a narrow container).
- `locale?: string`
- `format?: (n: number) => string` — Format of the value, the ends and the target.
- `class?: string`

### BigNumber

```svelte
<BigNumber {value} />
```

Props:
- `value: number | string` — A number (formatted with `format`, animated) or a text shown as is.
- `prefix?: string` — Text before the figure ("$", "#").
- `unit?: string` — Text after the figure, smaller ("%", "players").
- `label?: string` — Caption under the figure.
- `size?: "md" | "lg" | "xl"`
- `align?: "start" | "center"`
- `animate?: boolean` — Counts up from zero when it comes into view.
- `duration?: number` — Length of the count, in ms.
- `color?: string` — Any CSS colour for the figure; by default the text colour.
- `locale?: string`
- `format?: (n: number) => string` — Format of the number.
- `class?: string`

### IconArray

- `columns?: number` — Marks per row; by default up to 10.
- `shape?: "circle" | "square" | "person"`
- `size?: number` — Size of a mark, in px.
- `color?: string` — Any CSS colour for the filled marks; by default the accent.
- `showSummary?: boolean` — Shows the count and the label under the grid.
- `countLabel?: string` — "{n} of {total}".
- `icon?: Snippet<[{ filled: boolean; index: number }]>` — Your own mark, drawn inside a 24×24 viewBox.
- `class?: string`

### ChartCard

The frame of a chart or any other block of a dashboard.


### PageHeader

The top of a page, the same on every page.

```svelte
<PageHeader title="Posts" description="Everything published on the site.">
  {#snippet breadcrumb()}<Breadcrumb items={trail} />{/snippet}
  {#snippet status()}<Badge variant="success" dot>Published</Badge>{/snippet}
  {#snippet meta()}Updated 2 hours ago by Ana{/snippet}
  {#snippet actions()}<Button variant="secondary">Export</Button><Button>New post</Button>{/snippet}
  {#snippet tabs()}<Tabs panels={false} items={sections} bind:value={section} />{/snippet}
</PageHeader>
```

Props:
- `title: string`
- `level?: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6` — Heading level of the title.
- `description?: string`
- `divider?: boolean` — A rule under the header (or under the tabs).
- `class?: string`
- `breadcrumb?: Snippet` — Above the title: a Breadcrumb, or a "back" link.
- `status?: Snippet` — Next to the title: a status Badge.
- `meta?: Snippet` — A quiet line under the title: who, when, an id.
- `actions?: Snippet` — The page's actions, right-aligned; the primary one last.
- `tabs?: Snippet` — Tabs (with `panels={false}`) or another sub-navigation, under the header.
- `children?: Snippet` — Richer content in place of `description`.

### FilterBar

The filters of a list, from a declaration.

```svelte
<FilterBar bind:value={query} onchange={load} filters={[
  { key: "status", label: "Status", type: "select", options: ["Draft", "Published"] },
  { key: "featured", label: "Featured", type: "boolean" },
  { key: "since", label: "Published since", type: "date", hidden: true },
  { key: "period", label: "Period", type: "date", range: true, hidden: true },
  { key: "author", label: "Author", type: "text", hidden: true },
]} />
```

Props:
- `filters: FilterDef[]`
- `value?: FilterValues` — What is applied, by key (bindable).
- `search?: boolean` — Shows the search field.
- `searchKey?: string` — The key of the search text in `value`.
- `searchPlaceholder?: string`
- `searchLabel?: string` — Accessible name of the search field; the placeholder by default.
- `ariaLabel?: string` — Accessible name of the bar.
- `addFilterLabel?: string`
- `clearAllLabel?: string`
- `locale?: string` — Language of the date filters' calendar.
- `class?: string`
- `onchange?: (value: FilterValues) => void`
- `end?: Snippet` — Your own controls at the end of the row.

### FilterChip

One filter of a list as a chip.

```svelte
<FilterChip label="Status" type="select" options={["Draft", "Published"]} bind:value={status} />
```

Props:
- `label: string` — The filter's name ("Status").
- `type: FilterType`
- `options?: FilterOption[]` — The choices of a "select".
- `value?: FilterChipValue` — `null` when the filter is not applied.
- `removable?: boolean` — Shows the remove button while the chip has a value.
- `placeholder?: string` — Placeholder of the "text" field.
- `range?: boolean` — A "date" filter takes two dates, stored as "start..end".
- `locale?: string` — Language of the "date" calendar.
- `removeLabel?: string` — Accessible name of the remove button; "{filter}" is replaced by the label.
- `anyLabel?: string` — The entry that clears a "select" or "boolean".
- `yesLabel?: string`
- `noLabel?: string`
- `class?: string`
- `onchange?: (value: FilterChipValue) => void`
- `onremove?: () => void` — The remove button was pressed (after the value was cleared).

### EmptyState

What a list, a table or a page shows instead of its content.

```svelte
<EmptyState title="No posts yet" description="Write the first one." actionLabel="New post" onAction={create} />
```

Props:
- `variant?: "empty" | "no-results" | "error"`
- `title?: string` — By default: "Nothing here yet", "No results for these filters", "Something went wrong".
- `description?: string`
- `icon?: IconName | Snippet | false` — A kit icon by name, your own drawing as a snippet, or `false` for none.
- `level?: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | null` — Heading level of the title; `null` makes it a plain paragraph (inside a table cell).
- `size?: "sm" | "md"` — `sm`: inside a table or a card; `md`: a page or a panel of its own.
- `actionLabel?: string` — The primary action ("New post"): a button with `onAction`, a link with `actionHref`.
- `onAction?: () => void`
- `actionHref?: string`
- `onClearFilters?: () => void` — Adds the "Clear filters" button.
- `clearFiltersLabel?: string`
- `onRetry?: () => void` — Adds the "Retry" button.
- `retryLabel?: string`
- `retrying?: boolean` — The retry is running: the button shows it and cannot be pressed again.
- `class?: string`
- `actions?: Snippet` — Your own buttons, instead of the ones above.
- `children?: Snippet` — Extra content under the description.

### SaveBar

The footer of a form.

```svelte
<SaveBar>…</SaveBar>
```

Props:
- `dirty?: boolean` — The form has changes that are not saved.
- `saving?: boolean` — The save is running.
- `error?: string` — The save failed: this text replaces the state.
- `savedText?: string` — What the bar says when there is nothing to save ("Saved 2 minutes ago").
- `form?: string` — The id of the `<form>` the buttons submit, when the bar is outside it.
- `secondaryActions?: SaveBarAction[]` — Other ways of saving, between Cancel and Save.
- `disableWhenClean?: boolean` — Save (and the secondary actions) cannot be pressed until `dirty`.
- `sticky?: boolean`
- `saveLabel?: string`
- `cancelLabel?: string`
- `dirtyText?: string`
- `savingText?: string`
- `ariaLabel?: string` — Accessible name of the bar.
- `onSave?: (event: MouseEvent) => void`
- `onCancel?: () => void` — Shows Cancel as a button.
- `cancelHref?: string` — Shows Cancel as a link (back to the list).
- `class?: string`
- `children?: Snippet` — Extra content on the left, after the state (a "Delete" button, a note).

### DiffView

Before and after of a record.

```svelte
<DiffView changes={[
  { field: "title", label: "Title", before: "Hello", after: "Hello, world" },
  { field: "tags", label: "Tags", before: null, after: ["news"] },
  { field: "excerpt", label: "Excerpt", before: "Old text", after: null },
]} />
```

Props:
- `changes: DiffChange[]`
- `compact?: boolean` — One line per change.
- `showUnchanged?: boolean` — Also list the fields whose value did not change.
- `collapseAfter?: number` — Characters after which a value is folded behind "Show more" (0: never).
- `format?: (value: unknown, change: DiffChange) => string | undefined` — Writes a value yourself; return `undefined` to keep the default.
- `ariaLabel?: string` — Accessible name of the list.
- `beforeLabel?: string`
- `afterLabel?: string`
- `addedLabel?: string`
- `removedLabel?: string`
- `changedLabel?: string`
- `emptyValueLabel?: string` — What a missing value is called ("empty").
- `showMoreLabel?: string`
- `showLessLabel?: string`
- `emptyText?: string` — Shown when there is nothing to list.
- `class?: string`

### Kbd

A keyboard shortcut hint.

```svelte
<Kbd keys={["Mod", "K"]} />        ⌘K on a Mac, Ctrl+K elsewhere
<Kbd keys={["Shift", "Enter"]} />
```

Props:
- `keys?: string[]` — The keys of the combination, in order. `Mod` is ⌘ on a Mac and Ctrl elsewhere.
- `platform?: "auto" | "mac" | "other"`
- `separator?: string` — Text between the keys when they are not Mac symbols ("+" by default).
- `size?: "sm" | "md"`
- `class?: string`
- `children?: import("svelte").Snippet` — A single key as content, instead of `keys`.

### DescriptionList

Label / value pairs of a record (its "About" panel.

```svelte
<DescriptionList ariaLabel="About" items={[
  { label: "Created", value: "3 Nov 2026, 10:12" },
  { label: "Author", value: "Ana López", href: "/users/ana" },
  { label: "API path", value: "/api/posts/42", copy: true },
]} />
```

Props:
- `items: DescriptionItem[]`
- `layout?: "auto" | "stacked"` — `auto`: side by side when there is room, stacked when narrow.
- `columns?: 1 | 2 | 3` — Columns of pairs (stacked) when the list is wide enough.
- `ariaLabel?: string` — Accessible name of the list.
- `emptyValue?: string` — What a missing value shows.
- `copyLabel?: string`
- `copiedLabel?: string`
- `class?: string`
- `value?: Snippet<[DescriptionItem]>` — Draws a value yourself; gets the item. Return nothing special: it replaces the text.

### SavedViews

Named views of a list (a set of filters, a sort, the columns).

```svelte
<SavedViews {views} bind:current query={filters}
  onSelect={(view) => (filters = view.query)}
  onSave={(view) => store.put(view)}
  onRename={(view, name) => store.rename(view.name, name)}
  onDelete={(view) => store.remove(view.name)} />
```

Props:
- `views: SavedView<Q>[]`
- `current?: string | null` — Name of the active view (bindable); `null` when none is.
- `query?: Q` — What "Save current view…" stores.
- `label?: string` — Text of the button when no view is active, and name of the menu.
- `saveLabel?: string`
- `renameLabel?: string` — "{name}" is replaced by the active view's name.
- `deleteLabel?: string`
- `deleteConfirmTitle?: string`
- `nameLabel?: string`
- `emptyText?: string`
- `class?: string`
- `onSelect?: (view: SavedView<Q>) => void`
- `onSave?: (view: SavedView<Q>) => void`
- `onRename?: (view: SavedView<Q>, name: string) => void`
- `onDelete?: (view: SavedView<Q>) => void`

### AppShell

The frame of an application.

```svelte
<AppShell>
  {#snippet sidebar({ mobile, close })}
    <Sidebar {groups} {current} collapsible={!mobile} persistKey={mobile ? undefined : "nav"} />
  {/snippet}
  {#snippet breadcrumb()}<Breadcrumb items={trail} />{/snippet}
  {#snippet command()}<Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onclick={openPalette}>Search <Kbd keys={["Mod", "K"]} /></Button>{/snippet}
  {#snippet user()}<Avatar name="Ana López" size="sm" />{/snippet}
  …the page…
</AppShell>
```

Props:
- `breakpoint?: "sm" | "md" | "lg"` — Below it the sidebar becomes a sheet behind a menu button.
- `sidebarOpen?: boolean` — The phone sheet is open (bindable).
- `height?: string` — Height of the frame (a CSS length), or "auto" to let the document scroll.
- `landmarks?: boolean` — `false`: no <header> / <main> / skip link, for a shell inside a page that has them.
- `mainId?: string` — Id of the content region (the skip link's target).
- `menuLabel?: string` — Accessible name of the menu button.
- `navLabel?: string` — Accessible name of the phone sheet.
- `skipLabel?: string`
- `closeLabel?: string`
- `class?: string`
- `sidebar?: Snippet<[{ mobile: boolean; close: () => void }]>` — The navigation (a Sidebar). Gets `{ mobile, close }`: whether it is in the sheet, and how to close it.
- `breadcrumb?: Snippet` — Start of the top bar, after the menu button: where you are.
- `command?: Snippet` — End of the top bar: the button that opens the command palette.
- `user?: Snippet` — End of the top bar, last: the user menu.
- `topbar?: Snippet` — Anything else in the top bar, between the command button and the user.
- `children?: Snippet` — The page.

### Thinking

A model's reasoning as a block that stays out of the way.

```svelte
<Thinking running={busy} summary={currentStep}>{reasoning}</Thinking>
```

Props:
- `running?: boolean` — The model is still reasoning.
- `summary?: string` — What it is doing right now, in one line.
- `seconds?: number` — Elapsed seconds; without it the component counts while `running`.
- `steps?: string[]` — The trace as a list of steps.
- `open?: boolean` — The trace is shown (bindable).
- `runningLabel?: string` — Label while running ("Thinking…").
- `doneLabel?: string` — Label once done; "{time}" is replaced ("Thought for {time}").
- `class?: string`
- `onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void`
- `children?: Snippet` — The trace as free content (the reasoning text).

### StreamingText

An answer drawn as it arrives.

```svelte
<StreamingText text={answer} streaming={busy} />             the page appends to `answer`
<StreamingText stream={response.textStream} onDone={save} />  or hand it an async iterable
```

Props:
- `text?: string` — The text so far; it grows as the answer arrives.
- `stream?: AsyncIterable<string>` — Chunks of text to append as they come, instead of `text`.
- `streaming?: boolean` — The answer is still arriving (with `stream` the component knows by itself).
- `caret?: boolean` — Shows the caret while streaming.
- `class?: string`
- `onDone?: (text: string) => void` — A `stream` ended; gets the full text.

### ToolChips

What an agent did, as a compact run of chips.

```svelte
<ToolChips messages={2} calls={[
  { id: "1", verb: "Read", target: "brief.md", icon: "file" },
  { id: "2", verb: "Write", target: "Schedule.tsx", icon: "edit", added: 74, removed: 41 },
  { id: "3", verb: "Run", target: "pnpm test", icon: "terminal", status: "running" },
  { id: "4", verb: "Publish", target: "post #42", name: "publish_post", args: { id: 42 }, result: "ok" },
]} />
```

Props:
- `calls: ToolChipCall[]`
- `messages?: number` — How many messages the run produced, for the header.
- `summary?: string` — The header's text, instead of the generated count.
- `open?: boolean` — The run is shown (bindable).
- `collapsible?: boolean` — `false`: no header, only the list.
- `ariaLabel?: string` — Accessible name of the list when there is no header.
- `class?: string`
- `onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void`

### TaskList

The live status of what an agent is working on.

```svelte
<TaskList tasks={[
  { id: "a", title: "Collect match data", status: "done", meta: "12 s" },
  { id: "b", title: "Recompute tier list", status: "running", done: 3, total: 8, detail: "Fire, Water, Grass done" },
  { id: "c", title: "Write the summary", status: "pending" },
]} />
```

Props:
- `tasks: TaskItem[]`
- `variant?: "list" | "capsule"`
- `open?: boolean` — Capsule: the list is unfolded (bindable).
- `expanded?: string[]` — Ids of the rows whose details are shown (bindable).
- `label?: string` — Accessible name of the list.
- `labels?: Partial<Record<TaskStatus, string>>` — Word per status, read by screen readers; the kit's labels by default.
- `class?: string`
- `details?: Snippet<[TaskItem]>` — Draws a row's details yourself; gets the task.

### ApprovalCard

A human-in-the-loop request as one card.

```svelte
<ApprovalCard
  requester="Publisher agent"
  title="Publish “Patch 1.2 notes” on Valhalla"
  description="The post goes live now and the home page is rebuilt."
  changes={[{ field: "status", label: "Status", before: "In review", after: "Published" }]}
  risk="Visible to every visitor. It can be unpublished, but feeds may already have it."
  riskLevel="medium"
  onApprove={approve} onReject={reject} onEdit={openEditor} />
```

Props:
- `title: string` — What will happen if approved, as one sentence.
- `requester?: string` — Who asks (an agent, a person).
- `description?: string`
- `changes?: DiffChange[]` — The record's field changes.
- `tool?: string` — The tool the agent wants to call, and its arguments.
- `args?: Record<string, unknown>`
- `risk?: string` — What could go wrong, in a sentence.
- `riskLevel?: "low" | "medium" | "high"`
- `status?: Status`
- `outcome?: string` — The line shown once decided ("Approved by Ana · 2 min ago").
- `level?: 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6` — Heading level of the title.
- `shortcuts?: boolean` — Mod+Enter and Mod+Backspace while focus is in the card, and their hints.
- `approveLabel?: string`
- `rejectLabel?: string`
- `editLabel?: string`
- `requestLabel?: string` — The eyebrow over the title ("Approval requested").
- `class?: string`
- `onApprove?: () => void | Promise<void>`
- `onReject?: () => void | Promise<void>`
- `onEdit?: () => void` — Shows "Edit first".
- `children?: Snippet` — Your own content between the call and the risk note.

### ContextCards

What the model was given to work with (files, records, links, pasted text) as small cards.

```svelte
<ContextCards onRemove={drop} items={[
  { id: "1", title: "brief.md", type: "file", meta: "4.2 KB" },
  { id: "2", title: "Post #42", type: "record", meta: "posts", href: "/admin/posts/42" },
  { id: "3", title: "Patch notes 1.2", type: "link", meta: "valhalla.gg" },
]} />
```

Props:
- `items: ContextItem[]`
- `label?: string` — Accessible name of the list.
- `layout?: "row" | "stack"`
- `removeLabel?: string` — Name of the remove button; "{item}" is replaced by the card's title.
- `class?: string`
- `onRemove?: (item: ContextItem) => void` — Shows a remove button on every card.

### RecommendationCard

A suggestion from the model that the user can take or leave.

```svelte
<RecommendationCard
  title="Feature “Patch 1.2 notes” on the home page"
  description="It is the most read post of the week and the slot is free until Friday."
  reasons={["9,810 views in 7 days, 3× the average", "No featured post since Monday"]}
  confidence="high"
  actionLabel="Feature it" onAction={feature}
  secondaryLabel="Alternatives" onSecondary={more}
  onDismiss={hide} />
```

Props:
- `title: string`
- `description?: string`
- `reasons?: string[]` — Why it is suggested, one line each.
- `confidence?: "low" | "medium" | "high"`
- `level?: 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6`
- `actionLabel?: string`
- `onAction?: () => void | Promise<void>`
- `actionHref?: string`
- `secondaryLabel?: string`
- `onSecondary?: () => void`
- `onDismiss?: () => void` — Shows a close button.
- `dismissLabel?: string`
- `reasonsLabel?: string` — Heading of the reasons ("Why").
- `class?: string`
- `children?: Snippet`

### InsightCard

Something the model noticed in the data, said in a sentence and backed by the figure.

```svelte
<InsightCard
  title="Kaela's pick rate doubled after patch 1.1"
  label="Pick rate" value={18.4} unit="%" delta={9.1} deltaLabel="vs patch 1.0"
  trend={[9, 9.3, 9.1, 14.2, 17.8, 18.4]}
  text="The dash reset on takedown made her the default opener in ranked."
  actionLabel="Open the matchup table" actionHref="/meta/kaela" />
```

Props:
- `title: string` — The insight as one sentence.
- `label?: string` — What the figure measures ("Pick rate").
- `value?: number | string`
- `unit?: string`
- `delta?: number | null`
- `deltaLabel?: string`
- `goodWhen?: "up" | "down" | "none"`
- `trend?: number[]` — Recent values, oldest first.
- `text?: string` — A line of explanation under the figure.
- `tone?: "info" | "positive" | "warning" | "negative"`
- `level?: 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6`
- `locale?: string`
- `format?: (n: number) => string`
- `deltaFormat?: (n: number) => string`
- `actionLabel?: string`
- `actionHref?: string`
- `onAction?: () => void`
- `class?: string`
- `children?: Snippet`

### RadarChart

Several measures of the same thing on one shape (a character's stats, a deck's profile), for one item or a few compared.

```svelte
<RadarChart title="Kaela against Oskar" axis="stat" max={100}
  data={[
    { stat: "Damage", kaela: 92, oskar: 55 },
    { stat: "Mobility", kaela: 88, oskar: 40 },
    { stat: "Defence", kaela: 35, oskar: 90 },
    { stat: "Control", kaela: 50, oskar: 72 },
    { stat: "Support", kaela: 20, oskar: 64 },
  ]}
  series={[{ key: "kaela", label: "Kaela" }, { key: "oskar", label: "Oskar" }]} />
```

Props:
- `data: Record<string, unknown>[]` — One row per axis: `{ stat: "Damage", kaela: 92, oskar: 55 }`.
- `axis: string` — Key of the axis name in each row.
- `series: ChartSeries[]` — What is drawn: one polygon per series (up to four).
- `title: string`
- `hideTitle?: boolean`
- `max?: number` — End of the scale; by default a round number over the largest value.
- `levels?: number` — How many rings the grid has.
- `size?: number` — Width of the drawing in px (it shrinks to fit a narrower container).
- `axisLabel?: string` — Header of the axis column in the data table.
- `locale?: string`
- `format?: (n: number) => string`
- `emptyText?: string`
- `showDataLabel?: string`
- `hideDataLabel?: string`
- `class?: string`

### RollingCounter

A number whose digits roll, each on its own wheel, to the new value.

```svelte
<RollingCounter value={online} label="Players online" />
```

Props:
- `value: number`
- `label?: string` — What the number is, read before it ("Players online").
- `locale?: string`
- `format?: Intl.NumberFormatOptions` — Options for `Intl.NumberFormat` (grouping, decimals, currency…).
- `size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg"`
- `class?: string`

### CardStack

A deck of cards looked at one by one.

```svelte
<CardStack items={cards} bind:index label="Featured decks">
  {#snippet card(deck)}<DeckCard {deck} />{/snippet}
</CardStack>
```

Props:
- `items: T[]`
- `index?: number` — Position of the top card (bindable).
- `loop?: boolean` — After the last card comes the first.
- `peek?: number` — How many cards show behind the top one.
- `label?: string` — Accessible name of the stack.
- `previousLabel?: string`
- `nextLabel?: string`
- `class?: string`
- `onchange?: (index: number) => void`
- `card: Snippet<[T, number]>` — Draws one card; gets the item and its index.

### CalendarHeatmap

Activity by day over weeks or months (matches played, posts published, commits).

```svelte
<CalendarHeatmap title="Matches played" unit="matches"
  data={[{ date: "2026-10-01", value: 3 }, { date: "2026-10-02", value: 7 }]} />
```

Props:
- `data: CalendarHeatmapDay[]`
- `title: string`
- `hideTitle?: boolean`
- `start?: string` — First and last day shown (`YYYY-MM-DD`); by default the range of `data`.
- `end?: string`
- `weekStartsOn?: number` — First day of the week: 0 Sunday, 1 Monday (default).
- `unit?: string` — What is counted, after the figure in each day's text ("matches").
- `max?: number` — The value of the darkest shade; by default the largest in `data`.
- `levels?: number` — How many shades above empty.
- `color?: string` — Any CSS colour for the shades; the accent by default.
- `locale?: string`
- `format?: (n: number) => string`
- `lessLabel?: string`
- `moreLabel?: string`
- `emptyText?: string`
- `class?: string`

### DateRangePicker

Two dates, from and to.

```svelte
<DateRangePicker bind:value={range} name="period" />
```

Props:
- `value?: DateRange` — The two dates (bindable).
- `min?: ISODate`
- `max?: ISODate`
- `locale?: string`
- `weekStartsOn?: number`
- `presets?: DateRangePreset[]` — Quick ranges; `[]` shows none.
- `name?: string` — Submits the dates as `<name>_start` and `<name>_end`.
- `startName?: string`
- `endName?: string`
- `disabled?: boolean`
- `inline?: boolean` — Only the panel's content, in place.
- `ariaLabel?: string` — Accessible name of the group of two fields.
- `startLabel?: string`
- `endLabel?: string`
- `buttonLabel?: string`
- `class?: string`
- `onchange?: (value: DateRange) => void`

### SankeyChart

Where a quantity comes from and where it goes.

```svelte
<SankeyChart title="Where new players end up" unit="players"
  links={[
    { source: "Signed up", target: "Finished tutorial", value: 720 },
    { source: "Signed up", target: "Left", value: 280 },
    { source: "Finished tutorial", target: "Ranked", value: 410 },
    { source: "Finished tutorial", target: "Casual", value: 310 },
  ]} />
```

Props:
- `links: SankeyLink[]`
- `nodes?: SankeyNode[]` — Labels, colours and first order of the nodes; ids not listed are taken from the links.
- `title: string`
- `hideTitle?: boolean`
- `unit?: string` — What flows, after each figure ("players").
- `height?: number` — Height of the drawing in px.
- `width?: number` — Width used on the server and before the container is measured.
- `nodePadding?: number` — Vertical gap between the nodes of a column.
- `align?: "left" | "justify"`
- `locale?: string`
- `format?: (n: number) => string`
- `fromLabel?: string`
- `toLabel?: string`
- `valueLabel?: string`
- `emptyText?: string`
- `showDataLabel?: string`
- `hideDataLabel?: string`
- `class?: string`

## Components (`tallao/map`)

### GameMap

Thin wrapper over sveaflet (Leaflet) with the kit's theme.

```svelte
<GameMap />
```

Props:
- `center?: [number, number]` — Initial center [lat, lng].
- `zoom?: number`
- `markers?: Marker[]`
- `dark?: boolean` — Dark layer (Esri Dark Gray) by default; false = standard OpenStreetMap.
- `height?: string` — Map height (CSS).
- `attribution?: string` — Required tile attribution.
- `ariaLabel?: string` — Accessible name of the map.
- `class?: string`

## Components (`tallao/code`)

### CodeEditor

Code editor on CodeMirror 6 with the kit's theme.

```svelte
<CodeEditor />
```

Props:
- `value?: string`
- `language?: Language`
- `name?: string`
- `readonly?: boolean`
- `lineNumbers?: boolean`
- `ariaLabel?: string`
- `minHeight?: string`
- `maxHeight?: string`
- `class?: string`
- `onchange?: (value: string) => void`
